text: The online portal was unavailable for two hours for maintenance; uploads resumed afterwards.
A missing documents letter was sent for application AV-K4502 asking for a proof of residence.
Application AV-M4630 for the Child Activity Credit was approved for 300.00.
Application AV-K4805 for the Home Heating Rebate was refused: household income above the limit.
A Senior Transit Pass application, AV-P4711, was received at the Harbour office with a photo.
The desk announced the Harbour office renovation closure for 16 to 20 November.
Home Heating Rebate application AV-K4417 was received complete through the portal.
The French version of the Senior Transit Pass guide was corrected to match the English renewal period of two years.
